headline: GTA 6 hacker pleads guilty to Rockstar breach
summary: Arion Kurtaj, 21, pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar Games and leaking GTA 6 footage, a breach he carried out as a teenager in 2022.

claims.statement: Arion Kurtaj pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar Games and leaking GTA 6 gameplay footage.

claims.statement: Kurtaj was deemed fit to stand trial earlier this year and has since been released from a secure hospital.
